subject.title: feat(ui): make the working indicator an OpenClaw claw that pinches

question: Should the Control UI use this pinching claw as the canonical transcript working indicator instead of the recently shipped spark?
rationale: Correctness and proof are strong, but the permanent brand carrier is a subjective product choice and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Adopt the claw
options.body: Accept this focused implementation as the canonical OpenClaw-branded working indicator while preserving all existing behavior contracts.

options.title: Keep the spark
options.body: Decline the visual replacement and retain the recently shipped spark if maintainers prefer its simpler or more neutral appearance.

recommendation.title: Adopt the claw
recommendation.body: Accept this focused implementation as the canonical OpenClaw-branded working indicator while preserving all existing behavior contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current working-indicator feature in merged history and are the strongest available owner for this exact visual direction.
